name: Mickey Waffles & Cinnamon Churro Waffles
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Iconic Disney Cruise Line Mickey waffles and cinnamon-sugar churro waffles are made from refined white pastry batter with ~0.5g fiber and zero seeds or whole-grain husks.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab warm Mickey waffles or Churro waffles from the buffet with pure maple syrup or butter (skip strawberry/berry compote with seeds). Ask a chef for allergy-friendly/dairy-free Mickey waffles if strictly avoiding lactose.
watchOuts: Berry compote seeds at the topping bar
